# secobserve_periodic_tasks (Data Source)

Lists recorded runs of SecObserve's scheduled background jobs, most recent first. Read-only: SecObserve writes these itself as jobs run, and scheduling is controlled entirely through `secobserve_settings`' `*_crontab_minute`/`*_crontab_hour` attributes, not through this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check whether the license import has failed recently.
data "secobserve_periodic_tasks" "license_import" {
  task   = "Import SPDX licenses"
  status = "Failure"
}

output "recent_license_import_failures" {
  value = length(data.secobserve_periodic_tasks.license_import.tasks)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `status` (String) Only return runs with this status: `Running`, `Success` or `Failure`.
- `task` (String) Only return runs whose task name contains this (case-sensitive substring match).

### Read-Only

- `tasks` (Attributes List) Matching runs, most recent first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `duration` (Number) Duration in milliseconds, null while still running.
- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the run.
- `message` (String) Error message, if any.
- `start_time` (String) When the run started.
- `status` (String) `Running`, `Success` or `Failure`.
- `task` (String) Name of the task.
